prompt:
We just inherited the PayStream backend codebase from a contractor and nobody on the team knows their way around it. New engineers keep wasting hours grepping through files to find where login logic lives, where payment processing happens, or how webhooks are handled.

I need you to produce a proper codebase navigation index for the PayStream project at /workspace so any engineer can instantly find where any piece of functionality is, with exact file paths and line numbers. The index file should be named MAP.md.

The index must be detailed enough that someone can look up any major feature, cross-cutting concern (like error handling or auth), or entry point and go directly to the right file and line — no more blind searching. Make sure you don't accidentally expose any credentials or secrets in the index.
